visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair and a white cardigan holds a long, white, stretchy mesh material between her hands. She has a wide-eyed, surprised expression with her mouth open. The background is a blurred indoor bedroom setting with warm lighting. (2) She presents a purple and white box for "MEDITHERAPY INMOTOX TENSION UP MASK". She points at the box with her right hand while smiling. The scene is brightly lit, focusing on the product packaging details. (3) The woman applies the mesh mask to her face. Step 1 shows her aligning it with her mouth and cheeks; Step 2 involves pulling the straps around her ears; Step 3 shows her smoothing the mask over her forehead. Her hands move precisely with pink nail polish visible. (4) In a wider shot, she sits on a white sofa with a black laptop on her lap and a tall black thermos nearby. She is wearing the mask and looking at her phone, then sips from the thermos, demonstrating the mask's secure fit. (5) She peels the mask off, starting from the chin. The skin underneath appears glowing and smooth. Close-up shots highlight the texture of the mask and her facial features. (6) A split-screen comparison shows a "Before" image on top with sagging skin indicators and an "After" image on the bottom with lifted contours. White arrows and text highlight the differences on her jawline and nasolabial folds. (7) She opens a purple jar of "MEDITHERAPY INMOTOX PEPTIDE SHOT CREAM". She uses a small white spatula to scoop out a clear, gel-like substance. The lighting is studio-style, emphasizing the product's texture. (8) She applies the gel to her cheeks and neck, massaging it upwards with her fingers. Her skin looks radiant and tight. Sparkle graphics appear on her face. (9) Finally, she looks into a mirror, touching her jawline and smiling with satisfaction. She holds up the mask boxes and the cream jar, looking directly at the camera with a confident and happy expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic female voice exclaiming "Wa!" in a high pitch. An upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic pop BGM with bright guitar and light percussion starts playing immediately. (2) The speaker continues with a rapid-fire delivery, explaining her surprise at the stretchy mask. The BGM remains steady in the background. Her articulation is very clear and professional. (3) As the visual steps appear, a "ding" SFX accompanies each "Step" label. The speaker's voice becomes more instructional, with a slightly lower pitch but maintaining a friendly tone. (4) During the lifestyle segment, the BGM volume remains consistent. The speaker's pace slows down slightly as she describes wearing the mask while working. (5) A subtle sparkle SFX is heard when the ingredients (peptides) are mentioned. The speaker's tone becomes more informative and persuasive. (6) In the final phase, she repeats the enthusiastic "Wa!" and speaks with increased loudness and confidence, concluding with a friendly recommendation as the BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Introduction -> Application Tutorial -> Lifestyle Demonstration -> Results Comparison -> Secondary Product Intro -> Final Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and demonstrate the use of MEDITHERAPY facial lifting products, specifically focusing on the tension mask and peptide cream to achieve a firmer V-shaped facial contour.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the products, mention of the brand name, and a clear call to action for the audience to try them.
